en.title: P.L. 119-21 §70204(a)(2)(A) quotes words that are not in 26 U.S.C. §529A(b)(2)(B)
en.summary: The amending instruction inserts new words after “except as provided in the case of contributions under subsection (c)(1)(C)”. Section 529A(b)(2)(B) reads “except in the case of contributions under subsection (c)(1)(C)”: the quoted words do not occur, as written in 2014 and kept in later amendments. The Office of the Law Revision Counsel executed the insertion after the existing words to reflect the probable intent of Congress.
en.impact: No consequence is claimed: the consolidated Code already reads as intended. The instruction itself cannot be executed as written.
en.correction: In §70204(a)(2)(A), strike “except as provided in the case of” and insert “except in the case of”.

findings.act: Grading instructions for farm animals, Order of the Minister of Agriculture of Kazakhstan No. 3-3/517 of 10 October 2014

en.title: Beef cattle grading, paragraph 28: class I is written as “81-70 points”, so totals of 61–70 fall into no class
en.summary: Paragraph 28 of the grading instructions for beef cattle sets “elite – 71-80 points”, “class I – 81-70 points” and “class II – 51-60 points”. A total of 61 to 70 points matches no row: a cow scoring 65 receives no class for the complex of traits. The Russian and Kazakh texts read the same way.
en.impact: An animal with a total of 61–70 points cannot be assigned a class for the complex of traits.
en.correction: “Class I – 61-70 points” (Kazakh text: “I сынып – 61-70 балл”).

ru.title: Мясной КРС, п. 28: границы I класса записаны как «81-70 баллов» — сумма 61–70 не попадает ни в один класс
ru.summary: В п. 28 Инструкции по бонитировке крупного рогатого скота мясного направления границы I класса записаны как «81-70 баллов». Соседние строки — «элита – 71-80 баллов» и «II класс – 51-60 баллов». Сумма от 61 до 70 баллов не попадает ни в одну строку: например, корова с суммой 65 баллов класса по комплексу признаков не получает. Так в русском и казахском текстах.

en.title: Maral and sika deer grading, paragraph 20: the weight threshold for class III hinds is “(ISO-IBS kg)” instead of a number
en.summary: Paragraph 20 of the grading instructions for marals and sika deer assigns to class III the hinds “with a very low live weight (ISO-IBS kg)”: a placeholder stands where the weight should be. Class II is 170–184 kg, so a hind below 170 kg cannot be classed by weight. The Russian and Kazakh texts read the same way.
en.impact: A hind weighing less than 170 kg falls into no weight class.
en.correction: For the issuing ministry to restore the value from the approved text of the order.

quote_translations.second: Class II comprises animals with a lower live weight of 170 (one hundred and seventy) – 184 (one hundred and eighty-four) kg
quote_translations.third: Class III comprises hinds with a very low live weight (ISO-IBS kg) regardless of conformation.

ru.title: Маралы и пятнистые олени, п. 20: порог третьего класса маток — «(ISO-IBS кг)» вместо числа
ru.summary: В п. 20 Инструкции по бонитировке маралов и пятнистых оленей третий класс маток задан словами «с очень низкой живой массой (ISO-IBS кг)»: вместо числа в тексте стоит служебное обозначение. Второй класс — 170–184 кг, поэтому для матки с живой массой ниже 170 кг класс по массе не определяется. Так в русском и казахском текстах.
ru.correction: Восстановить число по утверждённому тексту приказа.

en.title: LFSS 2026 art. 18, II: the 2026 Finance Act cited under the number and date of the social security financing act itself (corrected on 23 May 2026)
en.summary: As published in the Official Journal of 31 December 2025, article 18, II, of Law No. 2025-1403 (2026 social security financing act) referred to « la loi n° 2025-1403 du 30 décembre 2025 de finances pour 2026 », that is, to the 2026 Finance Act under the number and date of Law No. 2025-1403 itself. The text adopted by the National Assembly left the number and date blank, so the discrepancy arose at publication. The rectificatif published in Official Journal No. 0120 of 23 May 2026 had already corrected it before Arxo's check of 22 October 2026.

en.title: CGI art. 199 sexdecies: the 2026 Finance Act replaces words that occur twice without saying which occurrence
en.summary: We applied article 29, 2°, of Law No. 2026-103 (2026 Finance Act) to the prior consolidated text of article 199 sexdecies of the General Tax Code. Point a) inserts a second occurrence of the words « de l'article D. 7231-1 du même code »; point b) then replaces those words with « du même II » without saying which occurrence, and the sentence in force refers to services « mentionnés au 16° du II du même II ». The discrepancy is in the adopted text itself: the final text adopted by the National Assembly (T.A. No. 227) and the authenticated Official Journal No. 0043 carry the same wording.
en.impact: No effect on the amount of the tax credit was identified; the intended reference (16° of II of article D. 7231-1 of the Labour Code) remains recognisable.
en.correction: A legislative coordination provision: in the second sentence of the second paragraph of 2 of article 199 sexdecies, replace « du II du même II » with « du même II ». A rectificatif cannot change wording that is in the adopted text.

en.title: CSS art. L. 136-4, IV, on Légifrance: the word « aux » dropped and « définiaux » run together after the 2026 social security financing act
en.summary: We applied article 18, I, 2°, of Law No. 2025-1403 to the prior consolidated version of article L. 136-4, IV, of the Social Security Code and compared the result with the versions published on Légifrance (LEGIARTI000053282498 from 31 December 2025 and LEGIARTI000053284767 in force since 21 February 2026). fr.summary: Nous avons comparé le « Guide 2026 sur la fiscalité des énergies » publié par le ministère de la Transition écologique (éditions du 30 mai et du 22 juillet 2026) à l'article L. 312-79 du code des impositions sur les biens et services (CIBS). L'écart est dans le Guide ; le tarif du code n'est pas en cause.

en.title: Rabbit grading, paragraph 10: the Russian and Kazakh texts set opposite culling conditions
en.summary: The Russian text of paragraph 10 recommends culling does “that raised fewer than 5 kits in each of the first two kindlings” and those with “more than two consecutive misses”. The Kazakh text of the same paragraph names does that raised “at least 5 kits” and misses “twice in a row”. The condition on the number of kits is reversed between the language versions, and the number of misses differs.
en.impact: Read literally, the Kazakh text recommends culling the more productive does.
en.correction: Kazakh text: “5-тен кем көжек өсірген”; the number of misses to be aligned in both versions by the issuing ministry.

en.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32: the 2026 head-of-household standard deduction is published as $24,150; the statutory rounding rule gives $24,175
en.summary: Section 63(c)(7)(B)(ii) increases the $23,625 base by the cost-of-living adjustment and rounds the increase down to the next lowest multiple of $50. With the C-CPI-U values published on 11 September 2025 the increase is $559.56, rounded to $550, giving $24,175. Rev. Proc. 2025-32, section 4.14(1), publishes $24,150: its increase of $525 is not a multiple of $50 and matches rounding the whole amount instead of the increase.
en.impact: The 2026 standard deduction of a head-of-household filer is $25 lower than the amount the statute gives. This is a difference in the deduction, not in tax: the tax effect depends on the filer's bracket.
en.correction: $24,175, or a published statement of the authority for rounding the whole amount.

en.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32: the 2026 section 6334(d)(4)(B) amount is published as $5,300; the statutory rounding rule gives $5,250
en.summary: Section 6334(d)(4)(C) increases the $4,150 amount by the cost-of-living adjustment (base year 2017) and rounds the increase down to a multiple of $100. For 2026 the increase is $1,167.12, rounded to $1,100, giving $5,250. Rev. Proc. 2025-32 publishes $5,300 in section 4.50 (wages exempt from levy) and section 4.35 (qualified disability trust deduction, which uses the same adjustment); the published increase, $1,150, is not a multiple of $100 and matches rounding the full amount, $5,317.12, down. Rev. Proc. 2024-40 shows the same pattern for 2025 in sections 2.35 and 2.51: $5,100 published, $5,150 under the statute.
en.impact: The per-dependent amount used to compute wages exempt from levy is $50 higher than the statute gives for 2026 and was $50 lower for 2025; holding the standard deduction constant, that is about $0.96 per dependent per week. The qualified disability trust deduction differs by the same $50.
en.correction: $5,250 for 2026, or a published statement of the authority for rounding the whole amount.
